record.question: Flood stage is the height at which a river begins to overflow its banks. Which one of the following will be the best flood-monitoring effort in real time?
options: monitoring of amount of discharge required for a river to leave its channel on time interval basis and making data available to the public.
construction of check dams and flood barriers along lower elevation of stream and river channels.
installation of hundreds of automatic gauge in flood prone river to measure stage in continuous basis and making the data available over internet.
deployment of disaster response teams with complete set of equipments during flood and rainy seasons.
